independent_unit: Starting school; four complete paired whole-grid vectors, not60 independent samples
primary: Mixed D catches/(12*36) minus same-H D-only rate at G0
reciprocal: Mixed G catches/(G*36) minus count-matched G-only rate; G-only shared across H
secondary: All raw school captures/launches/eligible contacts, per-contact realised success, bird entries, remaining fish; all outcome signs displayed

best_Donly_comparison.selection: Highest across-school mean D-only per-animal36T rate among H1/2/3
best_Donly_comparison.scope: Selected on this discovery bank; best tested, not global optimum
best_Donly_comparison.bootstrap: Reselect best D-only mean H separately within each resampled whole-school vector draw
best_Donly_comparison.heldout: Write best_tested_Donly.json after all60 complete; freeze H before held-out outcomes

bootstrap.resampling: One common school-index matrix across all9mixed cells, both species and all shared controls
bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory pointwise95% intervals only; n4, no familywise correction, no confirmatory optimal-cell selection

incomplete: No final whole-map primary analysis until all60 cells and physical reviews pass; failures retained, no replacement/omission
anchor: The eight exact replay cells are prior outcomes; count each school once and keep original pilot/follow-up reports unchanged
numerical: Existing finer-grid results remain in report; discovery map does not establish convergence
